name: Research questions and how each is tested
caption: Eight registered experiments, in the order the report presents them. Each links to a predeclared comparison family; an eligibility failure produces a documented unanswered question rather than a silent omission. The final column cross-references the RQ numbering used in the execution addendum, which groups the same comparisons differently.

name: Financial and valuation availability by issuer
columns: ['Company', 'Candidate financial/valuation variables', 'Mean nonmissing share', 'Variables above the 70% training gate']
caption: Descriptive coverage over origin months from December 2015. Each fitted model applies its own training-only 70% gate, so a variable can be eligible in later windows and not earlier ones.

name: Economic exposure map
caption: Economic relevance is recorded before any statistical selection. A driver marked unavailable stays unavailable: no commodity index is substituted for a price history that does not exist.

name: The six compact predictors used in every common-input comparison
caption: These six are fixed in configuration by economic priority, not chosen by fit, and are shared by the static, distributed-lag and dynamic families so that only model structure differs between them. The full dictionary of every implemented variable is in the appendix.

name: Scoring criteria and how to read them
caption: Return models are ranked primarily on RMSE and out-of-sample R²; variance models on QLIKE. Variance and volatility losses are never mixed, and directional accuracy is only applied to signed targets.

name: Return benchmarks and the main model families
caption: All models share the same origins, outcomes and historical-mean denominator. Out-of-sample R² below zero means larger total squared error than the benchmark a forecaster could actually have used.

name: E1 paired comparisons
caption: Positive means the expanded model reduced squared error. Intervals are 95% pointwise moving-block, six-month blocks, on matched dates.

name: E2 paired comparisons
caption: The middle row is the frozen primary contrast. All three use identical dates on both sides and retune both sides inside the same inner folds.

name: Frozen family: valuation added
caption: Holm adjustment is applied across all sixteen frozen contrasts, not within this row group. Block-resampling p-values are approximate for nested comparisons on 44 observations and are reported beside the interval, not in place of it.

name: E3 paired comparisons
caption: Each row changes one representation and holds everything else fixed. Missing rows indicate a representation whose inputs failed the coverage gate for that issuer rather than an economic equivalence.

name: Both cumulative ladders
caption: The protocol ladder adds financials first; the market-first ladder answers the separately required check of market and industry controls before company information. A block that looks useful in one ordering and not the other is sharing information, not proving its own value.

name: Leave-one-block-out
caption: Sign convention as elsewhere: positive favours the model named in the first column, so a positive value here means dropping the block improved the forecast.

name: E5 paired comparisons
caption: The first row is the frozen family member. Lag-length sensitivity is the second row; agreement between them is the evidence that matters.

name: E6 paired comparisons
caption: The first row is the frozen family member and the only one that isolates error dynamics. The second mixes the dynamics with the value of the predictors themselves.

name: Selected ARMA order by origin
caption: The order is chosen inside training data and changes over time, so this family is labelled "order selected in training" rather than given a fixed order in any figure legend.

name: Three-month horizon
caption: Each horizon uses its own matured historical-mean benchmark, so R² is comparable within a horizon and not across horizons.

name: Three-month, nonoverlapping calendar offsets
caption: All three offsets are reported rather than the most favourable one. Each holds only 12 to 13 independent outcomes, which is why these are descriptive.

name: Calendar-year performance
caption: 2026 is a partial year ending with the August target. Year-by-year splits of a 44-month sample are descriptive.

name: Excess-return target: stock minus market over the same month
columns: ['Company', 'Model', 'Months', 'QLIKE', 'Variance RMSE ×10⁶', 'Variance MAE ×10⁶', 'OOS R²', 'Vol. RMSE (daily pp)', 'Vol. forecast corr.']
caption: The realised market return belongs to this outcome, never to the predictors. Scored against the expanding mean of the same excess-return quantity.

name: Variance models
columns: ['Company', 'Model', 'Months', 'QLIKE', 'Variance RMSE ×10⁶', 'Variance MAE ×10⁶', 'OOS R²', 'Vol. RMSE (daily pp)', 'Vol. forecast corr.']
caption: QLIKE is the ranking score. Variance RMSE and volatility RMSE are shown beside it because a model can win on one and lose on another; disagreement is reported rather than resolved by picking a favourable metric.

name: Best observed variance model per issuer
caption: Retrospectively lowest observed score among tested pipelines. This is not a prospectively validated choice and the differences between the leading models are small.

name: E8 paired comparisons
caption: Paired QLIKE differences on matched months; positive favours the first-named model.

name: Daily-return correlation in high- versus low-volatility regimes
caption: Regimes are defined from trailing market volatility known at each date, not chosen after seeing the result. Intervals are synchronised moving-block resamples of the paired daily returns. A positive difference means the pair co-moved more when market volatility was already high, which is when diversification is least useful; this is a descriptive contrast, not a contagion test.

name: One row per experiment
columns: ['Experiment', 'Information or structure tested', 'Issuers compared', 'Median MSE reduction (pp²)', 'Issuers with interval above zero', 'Issuers with interval below zero']
caption: The variance row uses QLIKE, not squared error, so its magnitude column is deliberately blank: the two losses are not comparable and combining them into one ranking would be wrong.

name: Frozen configuration
caption: The complete frozen configuration, also saved as config.json. Penalty grids, order candidates, gates, seeds and block lengths were fixed before scoring.

name: Deferred and unavailable inputs
caption: Each remains visible as an explicit deferral. None was replaced by a substitute and none was dropped from the report’s scope statement.
